## Adaptation thresholds (docs/12-week-strategy.md §7)

- [ ] Outreach response < 10% after 3 active weeks → change targeting OR messaging (one at a time)
- [ ] Screen-to-rejection > 75% after 4 weeks → classify rejections, narrow band or pre-qualification
- [ ] Zero technical interviews by week 6 → pause new ATS applications for one week, audit funnel
- [ ] Compensation mismatch > 50% of rejections in a market → research that market's band
- [ ] Project milestone > 1 week late → shift 10% search time to training until recovered
- [ ] Switzerland consistently below Berlin after 4 comparable weeks → rebalance 10 points
- [ ] Admissible Tier C bridge above €70k with AI exposure → pursue as strategic bridge
